summary: Product requirements and acceptance plan for a simple Flask Todo web application with SQLite database and HTML/CSS interface.
scope: Build a simple Flask Todo web application with core CRUD operations (add, complete, delete), backed by an SQLite database, and presented through a straightforward HTML/CSS user interface.
acceptance_criteria: User can view all existing tasks on the main webpage.
User can input a task description and submit a form to add a new task to the SQLite database.
User can click a button or link to mark an incomplete task as complete, updating its status in the database.
User can click a delete button next to a task to remove it permanently from the database.
The web interface renders properly with basic HTML and CSS styling.
